title: Stacked Ensemble + MC Dropout Calibration Head for NBA Evolution Islands

sources.title: Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction analysis
sources.key_finding: Stacking NB+AdaBoost+MLP+KNN+XGBoost+DT+LR. CNN achieves lowest Brier ~0.221. MLP meta-learner on tree outputs outperforms any single model.

sources.title: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
sources.key_finding: RNN + Monte Carlo dropout (100 stochastic forward passes) + rolling-form indicators + shot-chart embeddings. Brier ~0.20, better calibration than deterministic models. Calibration uncertainty enables optimal Kelly sizing.

current_fleet_best.source: S22 venn_abers_fusion gen=39 (CPU tree + Venn-Abers calibration)

proposed_technique.name: MC Dropout Calibration Head on Tree Leaf Embeddings
proposed_technique.description: Add a lightweight MLP (2 hidden layers, 64→32 neurons) with MC dropout (p=0.1) on top of tree leaf index embeddings. During inference: 50 stochastic forward passes → mean probability + epistemic uncertainty. Uncertainty used for: (1) confidence-weighted Kelly sizing, (2) abstain when uncertainty > threshold.
proposed_technique.cpu_feasibility: YES — MLP head is tiny. Tree leaf embeddings are fixed once tree is trained. No GPU needed. Inference: ~20ms per game on CPU (50 passes × tiny MLP).
implementation_steps: 1. In evolution island: after tree model fit, extract leaf indices (model.apply(X) for XGB/LGB, model.decision_path(X) for sklearn).
2. Fit lightweight MLP head (sklearn MLPClassifier, max_iter=500) with dropout via custom layer or MC approximation via noise injection at eval time.
3. At inference: predict_proba 50× with random noise → mean and std. Std > 0.15 → flag as high-uncertainty bet.
4. Kelly sizing: use mean_prob for edge calc but scale stake by (1 - uncertainty_std). Reduces over-betting on uncertain games.
5. Add to CALIBRATION_OPTIONS as 'mc_dropout_mlp'. GA can mutate to include/exclude.
6. Target island: S22 (venn_abers_fusion rebuild window — natural experiment slot).
proposed_technique.alternative_simple: If MLP overhead is too high on CPU: use Venn-Abers calibrator (already shipped by FRANKENSTEIN today, 2026-04-21T16:03Z) with isotonic_temporal weighting as the calibration head. Simpler, already proven in S22.

expected_brier_delta: -0.005 to -0.015 (to reach ~0.205 target, closing half the gap to MDPI 2026 SOTA)
target_islands: S15 (Karpathy injection in progress — validate interaction)
kill_criterion: Brier improvement >= 0.002 over 3 consecutive generations vs control island
risk: MLP head may overfit on small CPU training sets. Mitigate: strong L2 regularization (alpha=1.0) + max 2 hidden layers.
status: PROPOSED — awaiting FRANKENSTEIN review and S22 rebuild completion
